title: Great is Thy Faithfulness

questions.question: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of his what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:1 (ESV): "I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of his wrath;"

questions.question: The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases; his mercies never come to an what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:22 (ESV): "The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases; his mercies never come to an end;"

questions.question: They are new every morning; great is your what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:23 (ESV): "they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness."

questions.question: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who does what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:25 (ESV): "The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him."

questions.question: It is good that one should wait quietly for the salvation of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:26 (ESV): "It is good that one should wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD."

questions.question: He has made my flesh and my skin waste away; he has broken my what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:4 (ESV): "He has made my flesh and my skin waste away; he has broken my bones;"

questions.question: He has besieged and enveloped me with bitterness and what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:5 (ESV): "he has besieged and enveloped me with bitterness and tribulation;"

questions.question: For the Lord will not cast off for how long?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:31 (ESV): "For the Lord will not cast off forever,"

questions.question: He does not afflict from his heart or grieve the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:33 (ESV): "For he does not afflict from his heart or grieve the children of men."

questions.question: Let us test and examine our ways, and return to whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:40 (ESV): "Let us test and examine our ways, and return to the LORD!"

questions.question: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:27 (ESV): "It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth."

questions.question: You have wrapped yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can do what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:44 (ESV): "You have wrapped yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can pass through."

questions.question: I have become a laughingstock to all my people, the object of their what all day long?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:14 (ESV): "I have become a laughingstock to all my people, the object of their taunt-songs all day long."

questions.question: Who is it that speaks and it comes to pass, unless the Lord has commanded it?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:37 (ESV): "Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has commanded it?"

questions.question: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that good and bad do what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 3:38 (ESV): "Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that good and bad come?"

key_verse_text: The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
